column3: Static files (index.html, app.js, style.css) hold no user data; all per-visitor data comes from /api, which is no-store.
Comments in the public app.js explain the code (e.g. "never innerHTML"); no secrets or internal hosts.
False positive: index.html is a static file and never reflects the query string; ZAP matched the form default values it submitted.
Intended: API responses are no-store because they hold per-visitor ledger data.
CSP sets default-src plus base-uri, form-action and frame-ancestors; reviewed, no missing directive weakens it for this same-origin page.
Informational: the page is a small JavaScript app.
Informational: the signed workspace cookie is the intended session.
